text.en:
Mandated Price Ceiling for Selected Basic Necessities. A
mandated price ceiling for selected pork and chicken products shall be implemented
in the National Capital Region, as follows:
THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES

Basic Necessity
Mandated Price Ceiling
Kasim/Pigue
Dressed Chicken
PhP270.00 per kilo
PhP300.00 per kilo
PhP160.00 per kilo

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately upon publication
in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation, and shall remain in full
force and effect for sixty (60) days from said date, unless the same is extended by the
President upon the recommendation of the DA.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 1stday of February
Lord, Two Thousand and Twenty One.
, in the year of our
By the President:
SALVADOR C. MEDIALDEA
Executive Secretary
REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES
Office of the President
MALACANANG RECORDS OFFICE
ATTY. CONCEPCIOR ZEM TE. FERROLINO-ERAD
